heritage.name: Heritage
heritage.note: Closest to what you have: the greys stay, navy becomes maroon, mint becomes gold.

campus.name: Campus
campus.note: The app's own colours: two gold ribbons, one maroon, one cream.

warm.name: Warm Stone
warm.note: Heritage with warm greys, so it sits comfortably on cream.

cream.name: Cream & Gold
cream.note: Made for the maroon sign-in screen — light ribbons that glow on it.

gold.name: All Gold
gold.note: One metal in four tones. Feels like a medal; strongest on maroon.

maroon.name: All Maroon
maroon.note: Four shades of the school colour. Elegant on cream, weak on maroon.

collegiate.name: Collegiate
collegiate.note: Maroon, navy and gold — a varsity-jacket palette that keeps your navy.

festival.name: Festival
festival.note: Gold, crimson and amber. Loud and happy — a Siglakas mood.

maroon.name: Maroon & Gold
maroon.note: Maroon background, cream bubble, a gold cap.

sunset.name: Gold to Maroon
sunset.note: Gold at the top fading into maroon, with a dark cap.

gold.name: Gold
gold.note: A bright gold icon that stands out on any home screen.

night.name: Deep Maroon
night.note: Dark and quiet, with a gold bubble.

cream.name: Cream
cream.note: A light icon with a maroon cap — soft, but pale on light wallpapers.
